notes: Advanced Skills + Plugin system. Skills: full SKILL.md parser (YAML frontmatter), variable/template expansion ($ARGUMENTS, shell, @path), install from directory/ZIP/GitHub, search, categories/tags, enable/disable, delete, update, path-traversal protection, and a permission-gated execution engine that respects existing security policies. Plugins: safe ZIP/tar.gz extraction (path-traversal + decompression-bomb guards), format adapters for Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini bundles, runtime detection (Python/Node/Bun/Ruby/Perl/PHP), and bounded tool execution with timeout and loop-budget. MCP: OAuth 2.1 PKCE + HMAC integrity helpers. New Skills & Plugins screen with search, filters, details, permissions, and execution history. Ported/adapted from AndroidHarness 4.0 (MIT) with attribution. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2).
